item.title: Ramu Grid suffers total system outage, restoration expected within 12 hours
item.description: PNG Power has advised customers that the Ramu Grid is currently experiencing a total system outage following an early morning technical fault at the Ramu Hydropower Station. According to the utility provider, Ramu Units tripped instantly due to low penstock pressure after heavy debris blocked the intake trash-racks at the hydropower facility.
